top.headline: Nasdaq 100 ends worst week since 2020; S&P 500 and Dow in correction
top.why: A violent AI-led sell-off sets a fragile tone for Sunday evening's futures open and the Thanksgiving week. Risk of follow-through is high.
points: Week to 20 Nov: S&P 500 about -8.6%, Nasdaq 100 -10.4%, Dow -8%, Russell 2000 -7.5% (TradingView/Stocktwits).
Friday: S&P 500 fell 3.7% (SPY), seventh straight lower session; S&P and Dow confirmed correction territory.
Semiconductor ETFs fell 17-18% on the week; fear gauge at its highest since April 2025.
Bitcoin near $59,000, seventh straight weekly decline; Reuters says lowest in two years. Market scaled back Fed December cut expectations.
top.next: Futures reopen Sunday evening 22 Nov; Thanksgiving week brings retail and tech earnings and the Fed's preferred inflation gauge (IBD).

top.headline: Pochettino's first match in charge is Liverpool away on Sunday, with United 18th
top.why: The new manager gets no easing in: a bottom-three side visits fourth-placed Liverpool, so Sunday is the first read on whether the change has done anything.
points: United are 18th after 10 games: won 1, drawn 5, lost 4; last outing was a 4-4 home draw with Aston Villa
Pochettino replaced Michael Carrick during the November international break and keeps Bruno Fernandes as captain
Lisandro Martinez is back from suspension; Dorgu and Maguire are back in training; Baleba, Rashford, Sesko, Shaw and Ugarte are listed as sidelined
United are unbeaten in their last three visits to Anfield and did the league double over Liverpool last season
top.next: Liverpool v Manchester United at Anfield, Sunday 22 Nov 2026

top.headline: Anthropic mathematician claims a Claude-assisted proof of the Riemann hypothesis; unverified
top.why: If it holds, it is the biggest AI-in-research result yet; for now it is a single author's claim from the lab's own non-public model, on the day after Anthropic's listing. Verification will take time.
points: Levent Alpöge of Anthropic posted a four-page statement and a Lean-formalised proof on 20 Nov, saying he worked with Claude for about six weeks; he says it also covers the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis.
Per the BBC, the Lean proof runs to over 250,000 lines and used a non-public Claude version; Anthropic has issued no official announcement (SiliconANGLE).
Reaction is split: James Maynard says it would be 'a historic milestone' if it checks out; Terence Tao says verification is 'some way off'; Andrew Granville calls the write-up 'garbled' (Nature).
Timing, a day after Anthropic's IPO, has drawn criticism; Alpöge calls the cynical reading 'false'. The full paper has not been released.
top.next: No dated catalyst; watch for expert review of the Lean files and the full paper, which has not yet been released.

stories.headline: Two tanker incidents near Oman as Iran says a vessel hit a mine east of Hormuz
stories.why: Fresh Gulf shipping attacks keep Hormuz risk live for oil and Monday's index futures open. Cause of the incidents is not yet established.
points: UK maritime agency (UKMTO) reported two tanker incidents near Oman on 21 Nov, one a tanker hit by an unknown projectile near Khasab.
Iran said a vessel hit a mine east of the Strait of Hormuz.
Reuters headline only; full details not saved, so attribution of the cause is unconfirmed.
Gulf tension thread already running: Saudi Arabia also reported intercepting three Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh on 20 Nov.
stories.next: Further UKMTO advisories and oil's reaction when futures reopen Sunday evening (21 Nov PT).

desks.note: Also today: Denmark is pushing the EU to tighten travel curbs on Russians after a foiled plot (Reuters, headline only).

stories.headline: Google lets Target and Albertsons carts be built inside Search and Gemini
stories.why: Shopping is moving into AI chat, so the product-selection moment can happen on Google rather than the retailer's site. Brands that advertise with grocers should watch how products get chosen.
points: Google began rolling out Connected Apps for Albertsons, Safeway, Shaw's and Target in Search and the Gemini app in the US on 20 Nov, via its Universal Commerce Protocol.
Experian, H&R Block, Angi and Thumbtack are also named for Search.
Google has not said how products are chosen, who processes payment, or whether ads will appear (PPC Land's reading of the Google post).
stories.next: Angi and Thumbtack account linking in Search 'within weeks' per Google; no firm date.

stories.headline: Apologist Wes Huff admits plagiarism and steps back from ministry
stories.why: A prominent popular apologist (Rogan, Piers Morgan appearances) has conceded plagiarism, a credibility test for online apologetics and its scholarship standards.
points: On 19 Nov Huff posted on X that it was 'wrong and sinful' and he failed to uphold integrity
Dan McClellan compared a 2016 Tyndale Seminary paper on John's Gospel with Brian J Wright's earlier paper, alleging matching arguments and citation errors; others alleged further copying
Apologetics Canada, where he is vice president, will run a full review
He is a PhD student at Wycliffe College, Toronto
stories.next: Apologetics Canada review outcome; no date given.

stories.headline: Ethiopia: about 34 more Orthodox Christians killed in Arsi, UK condemns violence
stories.why: Open Doors counts nearly 100 Orthodox Christians killed since October in one Oromia area, and the UK government has now responded formally. A live global-Christianity persecution story.
points: At least 34 killed in Andato Kebele, Robe District, East Arsi Zone, on 5 Nov, per residents cited by Open Doors; toll may rise
Earlier attacks: the Ethiopian Orthodox Church says at least 60 killed last month; Open Doors counts nearly 100 since October
Government blames rebel groups; church members allege tension over settlement and call for an independent investigation
Foreign Office minister Kirsty McNeill (written answer to Desmond Swayne) condemned attacks on people and places of worship; WCC also condemned the pattern
stories.next: No dated catalyst; watch for any independent investigation or further attacks in Arsi Zone.

stories.headline: Lancet Psychiatry meta-analysis: escitalopram and duloxetine best sustain antidepressant response
stories.why: Rare head-to-head long-term comparison; relevant to anyone weighing how long and on what to stay on an antidepressant. Fluoxetine was the benchmark.
points: Network meta-analysis of 115 double-blind RCTs, 30,428 adults with unipolar depression, 21 drugs, searched to 27 Mar 2026
Versus fluoxetine, sustained response: escitalopram OR 1.62 (1.21-2.18), duloxetine OR 1.57 (1.08-2.26), agomelatine OR 1.40 (1.06-1.85)
Escitalopram and duloxetine also had lower all-cause discontinuation (OR 0.60 and 0.64)
Published 10 Nov 2026, Radboud UMC and Oxford (Cipriani) consortium
stories.next: No dated catalyst; watch guideline responses.
stories.study: Systematic review and network meta-analysis of RCTs, n=30,428 adults (mean age 45, 66% women); limitation: indirect comparisons, only 35 head-to-head trials (9,888 patients), heterogeneous continuation designs

stories.headline: Rockstar says GTA VI took $3.79bn in day-one sales, the biggest entertainment launch on record
stories.why: This is a Rockstar/Take-Two figure, but it resets expectations for the holiday console season and shows how much demand is sitting behind the game.
points: Rockstar's company estimate to the end of launch day (Thursday 19 Nov): $3.79bn worldwide, against roughly $800m for GTA V in 2013
32.5m units sold pre-release; Sensor Tower had put pre-launch revenue at $2.36bn and said over 80% of pre-orders were the $100 Ultimate Edition
Game is on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only; no PC version announced, and Metacritic shows 99
Rockstar workers are voting on union recognition (IWGB) until 26 Nov, with layoffs and an employment tribunal still in the background
stories.next: Rockstar union recognition vote closes 26 Nov 2026; no PC date announced
